description.value: Bella Coola Grizzly Tours & Adventure Resort is a family-operated wilderness destination in the Great Bear Rainforest offering guided grizzly bear and marine wildlife tours out of Bella Coola. Guests stay in private post-and-beam chalet log cabins set into the timber, or aboard the 42-foot vessel MV Nekhani during multi-day fjord expeditions. The resort sits at the end of the famously steep Highway 20 descent into the Bella Coola Valley, making it a dramatic destination for cyclists tackling one of BC's most remote routes.

address.value: 1953 Mackenzie Highway 20, Bella Coola, BC V0T 1C0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, open adventure resort with 2026 bookings available. Contact details (phone, address, email) are consistently repeated across multiple subpages and match OSM. No mention of bikes, bike storage, laundry, or cyclist-specific amenities anywhere in the website content; OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is not corroborated by website text so Wi-Fi is left null per rules.
concerns: OSM name is 'Bella Coola Grizzly Tours Resort' but the website consistently uses 'Bella Coola Grizzly Tours & Adventure Resort' — minor discrepancy, likely a truncation in OSM.
OSM address uses 'Alexander MacKenzie Highway' while the website uses 'Mackenzie Highway 20' — these refer to the same road (Highway 20) but the street name differs.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating resort accepting 2026 bookings, situated at a notable endpoint on Highway 20 that is highly relevant to touring cyclists completing the Bella Coola run.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort is at the terminus of the famously steep Bella Coola Hill (Highway 20), a significant destination for cycle tourists. Cyclist-specific amenity details would require direct contact with the resort.
